title: Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy for Acute Cholecystitis After 72 Hours of Symptoms
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare the clinical outcomes of early versus delayed laparoscopic cholecystectomies for acute cholecystitis with more than 72 hours of symptoms.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* proven echographic cholecystitis

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnancy
* immunosuppression
* severe sepsis
* perforated cholecystitis
* peritonitis
* cholangitis
* acute pancreatitis
